title: 11 Dead, Several Injured in Fuel Tanker Crash on Sanandaj-Hamedan Road
text:
11 Dead, Several Injured in Fuel Tanker Crash on Sanandaj-Hamedan Road"

"The head of the Traffic Police of Iran's Law Enforcement Command (Faraja) has announced that the fatal accident on the Sanandaj-Hamedan route was caused by a sudden technical failure in the braking system of a gasoline-carrying trailer."

"According to the official, the crash tragically resulted in the deaths of 11 compatriots, while a number of others also sustained burn injuries and other wounds in the incident.
